<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.13 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>PARTNERSHIP ACQUISITION AGREEMENT </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Partnership Acquisition Agreement (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), dated as of October&nbsp;27, 2026, is by and among Sagard
Holdings Investment I LP, a Canadian limited partnership (&#8220;<U>LP Seller</U>&#8221;), Sagard Holdings Management Inc., a Canadian corporation (&#8220;<U>GP Seller</U>&#8221; and, together with LP Seller, collectively, the
&#8220;<U>Sellers</U>&#8221; and each, a &#8220;<U>Seller</U>&#8221;), Sagard Private Income Fund Inc., a Maryland corporation (&#8220;<U>Buyer</U>&#8221;), and, solely with respect to Section&nbsp;1.4, Sagard Private Income Fund SPV I GP Inc., a
Canadian corporation (the &#8220;<U>GP</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>W I T N E S S E T H: </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, LP Seller is the sole limited partner of Sagard Private Income Fund SPV I LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the
&#8220;<U>SPV</U>&#8221;), and owns 100% of the outstanding limited partner interests of the SPV (the &#8220;<U>LP Interests</U>&#8221;); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, GP Seller is the sole shareholder of the GP, and owns 100% of the outstanding equity interests of the GP (the &#8220;<U>GP
Interests</U>&#8221; and, together with the LP Interests, the &#8220;<U>Interests</U>&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the GP is a special
purpose entity formed for the purpose of acting as the general partner of LP Seller and the general partner of the SPV, and performing its duties and obligations, and exercising its rights, under the limited partnership agreements of LP Seller and
the SPV and any other agreement to which LP Seller or the SPV is a party, in each case as further described in Section&nbsp;5.1; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the SPV holds a portfolio of loans and related unfunded commitment obligations set forth on <U>Schedule 1</U> to this
Agreement (the &#8220;<U>Portfolio Assets</U>&#8221;), which Portfolio Assets may be subject to liens or other encumbrances pursuant to that certain Revolving Credit and Security Agreement, dated as of June&nbsp;17, 2026, by and among the SPV, as
the borrower, Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC, as the servicer, the lenders from time to time party thereto, Atlas Securitized Products Administration, L.P., as administrative agent, Atlas Securitized Products, L.P., as lead arranger, U.S. Bank
Trust Company, National Association, as collateral agent and collateral administrator, U.S. Bank National Association, as custodian and document custodian, and the other parties thereto (as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or
otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Credit Facility</U>&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, in connection with the acquisition of
the Interests, Buyer will become the direct or indirect owner of 100% of the partnership interests of the SPV and, as such, is expected to assume certain responsibilities and obligations under the Credit Facility as the &#8220;Parent BDC&#8221; (as
defined in the Credit Facility); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the parties to this Agreement desire that the Sellers sell, transfer, convey and assign
to Buyer, and that Buyer purchases and acquires from the Sellers, the Interests and any and all rights and benefits incident to the ownership thereof; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants contained
herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties to this Agreement hereby agree as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;1.</B> <B><U>Sale and Purchase of the Interests; Closing</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.1 <U>Sale and Purchase</U>. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) LP Seller does hereby sell, convey, assign and deliver to Buyer, and Buyer does hereby purchase and acquire from LP Seller, the LP
Interests and any and all rights and benefits incident to the ownership thereof, for and in consideration of the issuance by Buyer, on the date of this Agreement, of that number of Class&nbsp;I shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of
Buyer (the &#8220;<U>Shares</U>&#8221;) equal to the quotient obtained by dividing (i)&nbsp;the Purchase Price by (ii)&nbsp;the net asset value per Share as of the date of this Agreement, as determined in accordance with Buyer&#8217;s valuation
policies and procedures; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) GP Seller does hereby sell, convey, assign and deliver to Buyer, and Buyer does hereby purchase and
acquire from GP Seller, the GP Interests and any and all rights and benefits incident to the ownership thereof, for and in consideration of Buyer&#8217;s acquisition of the SPV and its assets and liabilities, the representations and warranties set
forth in this Agreement, and for other good and valuable consideration set forth in this Agreement, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged by each of GP Seller and Buyer. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.2 <U>Closing</U>. The transfer of the Interests, free and clear of all Encumbrances (as defined below) (other than Encumbrances arising
under or in connection with the Pledge Agreement (as defined in the Credit Facility), pursuant to this Agreement shall occur and be effective as of the execution of this Agreement by all parties hereto on October&nbsp;27, 2026, simultaneously with
the issuance of the Shares to LP Seller (the &#8220;<U>Effective Time</U>&#8221;), which Effective Time shall be prior to Buyer&#8217;s election to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended
(the &#8220;<U>1940 Act</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.3 <U>Purchase Price</U>. The aggregate purchase price for the LP Interests (the &#8220;<U>Purchase
Price</U>&#8221;) shall be equal to $76,542,774.37. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.4 <U>GP Shareholder Approval; GP Consent; Admission as Substitute Limited
Partner</U>. GP Seller&#8217;s execution and delivery of this Agreement shall be deemed, for all intents and purposes, to constitute the written consent of GP Seller, as the sole holder of the GP Interests, approving the sale, transfer, conveyance
and assignment of the GP Interests by GP Seller to Buyer pursuant to this Agreement, as and to the extent such shareholder approval is required under the GP&#8217;s articles of incorporation, as amended to date, without the need for any further
action, resolution or execution of any additional document by GP Seller or the GP. The GP&#8217;s execution and delivery of this Agreement shall be deemed, for all intents and purposes, to constitute the written consent of the GP, as the sole
general partner of the SPV approving the sale, transfer, conveyance and assignment of the LP Interests by LP Seller to Buyer pursuant to this Agreement, as and to the extent such consent is required of the GP under Section&nbsp;20 of the Amended and
Restated Limited Partnership Agreement of the SPV, dated as of June&nbsp;17, 2026 (as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;<U>SPV LPA</U>&#8221;). Buyer&#8217;s execution and delivery of
this Agreement shall be deemed, for all intents and purposes, to constitute Buyer&#8217;s execution of a counterpart to the SPV LPA, and upon the transfer of the LP Interests to Buyer at the Effective Time, Buyer shall thereupon be admitted to the
SPV as a substitute limited partner in accordance with Section&nbsp;20 of the SPV LPA, without the need for any further action, consent or execution of any additional document by any party and immediately following such admission, LP Seller shall
cease to be a limited partner of SPV. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;2.</B> <B><U>Representations and Warranties of Buyer</U></B>. Buyer
represents and warrants to each Seller, as of the date of this Agreement, as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.1 <U>Organization; Authority</U>. Buyer is a
corporation duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Maryland with full corporate power and authority to enter into and to consummate the transactions contemplated by this Agreement and otherwise to carry
out its obligations hereunder, and the execution, delivery and performance by Buyer of the transactions </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
contemplated by this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate action on the part of Buyer. This Agreement, when executed and delivered by Buyer, shall constitute a valid and
legally binding obligation of Buyer, enforceable against Buyer in accordance with its terms, except (a)&nbsp;as limited by applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, fraudulent conveyance and any other laws of general application
affecting enforcement of creditors&#8217; rights generally, (b)&nbsp;as limited by laws relating to the availability of specific performance, injunctive relief, or other equitable remedies, or (c)&nbsp;to the extent the indemnification provisions
contained herein may be limited by federal or state securities laws (the &#8220;<U>Bankruptcy and Insolvency Exceptions</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.2
<U>Investment Experience; Access to Information</U>. Buyer (a)&nbsp;either alone or together with its representatives has such knowledge and experience in financial and business matters as to be capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the
transactions contemplated by this Agreement and has so evaluated the risks and merits of such transactions, (b)&nbsp;has the ability to bear the economic risks of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement and can afford a complete loss,
(c)&nbsp;understands the terms of and risks associated with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, including a lack of liquidity, pricing availability and risks associated with the industry in which each of the SPV and the GP operates,
(d)&nbsp;has had the opportunity to review information regarding each of the SPV and the GP, its business, its financial condition and its prospects as Buyer has determined to be necessary in connection with the purchase of the Interests, and
(e)&nbsp;has had an opportunity to ask such questions and make such inquiries concerning each of the SPV and the GP, its business, its financial condition and its prospects as Buyer has deemed appropriate in connection with such purchase and to
receive satisfactory answers to such questions and inquiries. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.3 <U>Status</U>. At the time Buyer was offered the Interests, it was, and
at the date of this Agreement it is, an &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; as that term is defined in Rule 501(a) of Regulation D under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Securities Act</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.4 <U>Shares</U>. The Shares issued pursuant to this Agreement have been duly authorized and, when issued and paid for in accordance with the
terms of this Agreement, such Shares will be validly issued in compliance with applicable laws, fully paid, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-assessable,</FONT> and free of any Encumbrances (other than liens imposed under applicable securities
laws), and (a)&nbsp;shall not be issued in violation of, preemptive rights, purchase or call options, rights of first refusal, subscription rights, similar rights or the terms of any contract or other understanding binding upon Buyer and
(b)&nbsp;shall not be subject to any unsatisfied capital commitments. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.5 <U>No Conflicts; Advice</U>. Neither the execution and delivery
of this Agreement, nor the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, does or will violate any constitution, statute, regulation, rule, injunction, judgment, order, decree, ruling, charge or other restriction of any government,
governmental agency, or court to which Buyer is subject or any provision of its organizational documents or other similar governing instruments, or conflict with, violate or constitute a default under any agreement, credit facility, debt or other
instrument or understanding to which Buyer is a party. Buyer acknowledges that it has been provided with a copy of the Credit Facility and has had an opportunity to review the same. Buyer has consulted such legal, tax and investment advisors as it,
in its sole discretion, has deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with its purchase of the Interests. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;3.</B> <B><U>Representations and Warranties of the
Sellers</U></B>. Each Seller represents and warrants to Buyer, as of the date of this Agreement, as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.1 <U>Organization;
Authority</U>. Such Seller is duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of organization with full partnership or corporate power and authority, as applicable, to enter into and to consummate the
transactions contemplated by this Agreement and otherwise to carry out its obligations hereunder, and the execution, delivery and performance by such Seller of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement have been duly authorized by all
necessary corporate, partnership or similar action on the part of such Seller, as applicable. This Agreement, when executed and delivered by such Seller, shall constitute a valid and legally binding obligation of such Seller, enforceable against
such Seller in accordance with its terms, except (a)&nbsp;as limited by the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Exceptions. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.2 <U>Title to the
Interests</U>. Such Seller is the lawful owner of the Interests proposed to be sold by it hereunder (the LP Interests, in the case of LP Seller, and the GP Interests, in the case of GP Seller) with good and marketable title thereto, and such Seller
has the absolute right to sell, assign, convey, transfer and deliver such Interests and any and all rights and benefits incident to the ownership thereof, all of which rights and benefits are transferable by such Seller to Buyer pursuant to this
Agreement, free and clear of all the following of any nature whatsoever: security interests, liens, pledges, claims (pending or threatened), charges, escrows, encumbrances, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">lock-up</FONT> arrangements, options,
rights of first offer or refusal, community property rights, mortgages, indentures, security agreements or other agreements, arrangements, contracts, commitments, understandings or obligations, whether written or oral and whether or not relating in
any way to credit or the borrowing of money (collectively, &#8220;<U>Encumbrances</U>&#8221;); <I>provided</I>, that the LP Interests are subject to certain Encumbrances arising under or in connection with the Pledge Agreement (as defined in to the
Credit Facility). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.3 <U>No Conflicts; Consents</U>. Neither the execution and delivery of this Agreement by such Seller, nor the
consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, does or will violate any constitution, statute, regulation, rule, injunction, judgment, order, decree, ruling, charge or other restriction of any government, governmental agency, or court to
which such Seller or, as applicable, the SPV or the GP is subject, or any provision of the organizational documents of such Seller or, as applicable, the SPV or the GP, or conflict with, violate or result in a default under any material agreement,
credit facility, debt or other instrument or understanding to which such Seller or, as applicable, the SPV or the GP is a party, other than, in each case, any consents, waivers or approvals required under the Credit Facility that have been obtained
or will be obtained prior to the Effective Time. No consent, approval, order or authorization of, or registration, declaration or filing with, any governmental authority or other third party is required to be obtained or made by such Seller in
connection with the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement or the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, except for such consents, approvals, orders, authorizations, registrations, declarations or filings that have been
obtained or made, or will be obtained or made, prior to the Effective Time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.4 <U>No Indebtedness</U>. Neither the SPV nor the GP has
any outstanding indebtedness other than indebtedness arising under or in connection with the Credit Facility and funding obligations of the SPV under the Portfolio Assets. In addition, (i)&nbsp;the SPV is in compliance in all material respects with
its obligations under the Credit Facility as of the date of this Agreement, (ii)&nbsp;no &#8220;Event of Default&#8221; or &#8220;Default&#8221; (each as defined in the Credit Facility) has occurred and is continuing or would result from the
consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, and (iii)&nbsp;all consents, waivers and approvals required under the Credit Facility in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement have been obtained or will be obtained
prior to the Effective Time. Buyer has been provided with true, correct and complete copies of the Credit Facility and all material amendments, waivers, consents and notices of default or event of default given or received thereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.5 <U>Brokers</U>. No broker, finder, investment banker or other person is entitled to any brokerage, finder&#8217;s or other fee or
commission in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement based upon arrangements made by or on behalf of such Seller, the SPV or the GP for which Buyer, the SPV or the GP could become liable or obligated. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6 <U>Litigation</U>. There is no action, suit, investigation or proceeding pending or, to
the knowledge of such Seller, threatened against such Seller, the SPV or the GP before any court, arbitrator or governmental authority that seeks to enjoin, or that would reasonably be expected to materially delay or impair, the consummation of the
transactions contemplated by this Agreement, and neither the SPV nor the GP is subject to any outstanding order, judgment or decree that would reasonably be expected to materially and adversely affect the SPV, the GP or the Portfolio Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;4.</B> <B><U>Additional Representations, Warranties and Covenants of LP Seller</U></B>. LP Seller further
represents, warrants and covenants to Buyer, as of the date of this Agreement, as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.1 <U>Status</U>. At the time LP Seller was
offered the Shares, as of the date of this Agreement, and at the time that LP Seller purchases and acquires the Shares, it was, is, and will be, (a)&nbsp;an &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; as that term is defined in Rule 501(a) of Regulation D
under the Securities Act, (b)&nbsp;if LP Seller is in Canada, an &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; as defined in National Instrument <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">45-106</FONT> &#8211; Prospectus Exemptions or, in Ontario, Section&nbsp;73.3 of
the <I>Securities Act</I> (Ontario), as applicable, (c)&nbsp;a &#8220;qualified purchaser&#8221; within the meaning of Section&nbsp;2(a)(51) of the 1940 Act, (d)&nbsp;a &#8220;qualified client&#8221; as defined in Rule 205-3 under the Investment
Advisers Act of 1940, as amended, and (e)&nbsp;not subject to and is not aware of any facts that would cause LP Seller to be subject to any of the &#8220;Bad Actor&#8221; disqualifications as described in Rule&nbsp;506(d)(1)(i) to (viii)&nbsp;under
the Securities Act; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.2 <U>Investment Experience; Access to Information</U>. LP Seller has received, read carefully in their entirety,
and understands each of Buyer&#8217;s draft Form 10 Registration Statement relating to the Shares (as amended, restated and/or supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Form 10</U>&#8221;), Buyer&#8217;s bylaws (as amended
and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Bylaws</U>&#8221;), Buyer&#8217;s articles of incorporation (as amended and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Charter</U>&#8221;), the investment advisory agreement by and between Buyer and
Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC (the &#8220;<U>Adviser</U>&#8221;) and the administration agreement by and between Buyer and the Adviser. LP Seller (a)&nbsp;either alone or together with its representatives has such knowledge and experience in
financial and business matters as to be capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the Shares and make an informed decision regarding the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, and has so evaluated the risks and merits of the transactions
contemplated by this Agreement, (b)&nbsp;has the ability to bear the economic risks of ownership of the Shares and can afford a complete loss, (c)&nbsp;understands the terms of and risks associated with the acquisition of the Shares, including a
lack of liquidity, pricing availability and risks associated with the industry in which Buyer operates, (d)&nbsp;has had the opportunity to review information regarding Buyer, its business, its financial condition and its prospects as LP Seller has
determined to be necessary in connection with the acquisition of the Shares, and (e)&nbsp;has had an opportunity to ask such questions and make such inquiries concerning Buyer, its business, its financial condition and its prospects as LP Seller has
deemed appropriate in connection with such acquisition and to receive satisfactory answers to such questions and inquiries. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.3
<U>Origination</U>. Each Portfolio Asset that was originated by the SPV or an Affiliate (an &#8220;<U>Affiliate</U>&#8221; of any person or entity means any other person or entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under
common control with, such person or entity; for purposes of this definition, &#8220;control&#8221; (including the terms &#8220;controlled by&#8221; and &#8220;under common control with&#8221;) means the possession, directly or indirectly, of the
power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a person or entity, whether through the ownership of voting securities, by contract or otherwise) of the SPV was so originated without any fraud or material misrepresentation
by the SPV or its Affiliates, and each Portfolio Asset that was originated by an originator that, at the time of origination, was unaffiliated with the SPV was so originated, to the actual knowledge of LP Seller, without any fraud or material
misrepresentation by the originator of such Portfolio Asset. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.4 <U>No Defaulting Lender</U>. (x)&nbsp;Neither the SPV nor any of its Affiliates is a
&#8220;defaulting lender&#8221; (as such term or similar terms are defined in the applicable loan agreements governing such Portfolio Asset) as to any Portfolio Asset and no event has occurred that, with notice or the lapse of time, would result in
the SPV or any of its Affiliates being such a defaulting lender, and (y)&nbsp;to the actual knowledge of LP Seller, no other lender in respect of any Portfolio Asset is a &#8220;defaulting lender&#8221; (as such term or similar terms are defined in
the applicable loan agreements governing such Portfolio Asset) and no event has occurred that, with notice or the lapse of time, would result in any such other lender being such a defaulting lender. </P>

disclosed to Buyer prior to the date of this Agreement, and no lender accelerations, in relation to any loan agreements entered into with respect to any Portfolio Asset, and no event has occurred that, with notice or the lapse of time, would result
in such borrower default or lender acceleration. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.6 <U>Additional Agreements, Representations and Warranties</U>. To induce Buyer to

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) LP Seller shall direct any agent or administrative agent for any Portfolio Assets originated or acquired by LP Seller that are being
conveyed hereunder, and direct each obligor with respect to such Portfolio Assets, to remit all payments and collections as directed by Buyer. LP Seller will not make any change in its instructions to obligors regarding payments to be made to Buyer
or to the SPV inconsistent with the foregoing unless Buyer has consented to such change. In the event any payments relating to any Portfolio Asset or any other asset of the SPV are remitted directly to LP Seller or any designee of LP Seller (other
than Buyer or the SPV), LP Seller will remit (or will cause all such payments to be remitted) directly to Buyer or the SPV, as directed by Buyer, within five (5)&nbsp;business days following receipt thereof, and, at all times prior to such
remittance, LP Seller will itself hold or, if applicable, will cause such payments to be held in trust for the exclusive benefit of Buyer or the SPV, as directed by Buyer. Until so deposited, all such collections shall be held in trust by LP Seller
for the benefit of Buyer or the SPV, as directed by Buyer. In addition, if, following the Effective Time, it is determined that any lender, agent, administrative agent or other party under any loan agreement relating to a Portfolio Asset (each, an
&#8220;<U>Overpaid Debt Party</U>&#8221;) has received any overpayment or payment to which it was not entitled (whether by reason of miscalculation, duplicate payment, payment in excess of the amount then due, or otherwise), LP Seller shall, at
Buyer&#8217;s request, use commercially reasonable efforts to cooperate with Buyer and the SPV to recover such overpayment from the applicable Overpaid Debt Party, including by assigning to Buyer or the SPV any right of recovery or reimbursement
that LP Seller or any of its affiliates may have against such Overpaid Debt Party in respect of such overpayment. If, following the Effective Time, it is determined that the SPV or Buyer has received any overpayment or payment to which it was not
entitled from any borrower, obligor or other counterparty under any loan agreement relating to a Portfolio Asset (whether by reason of miscalculation, duplicate payment, payment in excess of the amount then due, or otherwise), Buyer shall, at LP
Seller&#8217;s request, use commercially reasonable efforts to cooperate with LP Seller to return or remit such overpayment to the applicable borrower, obligor or counterparty or, if such overpayment is properly owed to LP Seller or any of its
affiliates, to LP Seller or such affiliate, including by assigning to LP Seller any right of recovery or reimbursement that Buyer or the SPV may have against such borrower, obligor or counterparty in respect of such overpayment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) If, following the Effective Time, it is determined that the net asset value of the SPV as of the Effective Time, as finally calculated in
accordance with Buyer&#8217;s valuation policies and procedures applied on a basis consistent with the methodology used to determine the Purchase Price (the &#8220;<U>Final NAV</U>&#8221;), differs from the Purchase Price actually transferred or
credited to LP Seller at or prior to the Effective Time, then: (i)&nbsp;if the Final NAV was less than the Purchase Price, LP Seller shall, within five (5)&nbsp;business days following written notice from Buyer setting forth in reasonable detail the
basis for such determination (together with reasonable supporting documentation), pay to Buyer in immediately available funds an amount equal to the difference between the Purchase Price and the Final NAV; <I>provided</I>, that LP Seller shall have
the right, during such five (5)&nbsp;business day period, to review and verify the calculation set forth in such notice, and Buyer shall make available to LP Seller such books, records and work papers of the SPV as are reasonably necessary for such
review; and (ii)&nbsp;if the Final NAV exceeds the Purchase Price, Buyer shall, within five (5)&nbsp;business days following written notice from LP Seller setting forth in reasonable detail the basis for such determination (together with reasonable
supporting documentation), pay to LP Seller, at Buyer&#8217;s election, either (A)&nbsp;in immediately available funds an amount equal to such excess or (B), to the extent permitted by applicable law, a number of Shares having an aggregate value,
based on the net asset value per Share as of the date of this Agreement as determined in accordance with Buyer&#8217;s valuation policies and procedures, equal to such excess amount; <I>provided</I>, that Buyer shall have the right, during such five
(5)&nbsp;business day period, to review and verify the calculation set forth in such notice, and LP Seller shall make available to Buyer such books, records and work papers as are reasonably necessary for such review. </P>

hold, or discovers that it holds, any asset, right, record or property (including any books, records, bank accounts, agreements or rights of the GP relating to its role as general partner of the SPV) that properly belongs to Buyer, the GP or the SPV

record or property in trust for the exclusive benefit of Buyer, the GP or the SPV, as applicable. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;8.</B>
<B><U>Indemnification</U></B>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) LP Seller shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Buyer (and its respective affiliates, directors,
officers, employees, successors and assigns) from and against any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees) (collectively, &#8220;<U>Losses</U>&#8221;) based upon, arising out of or
otherwise in respect of (i)&nbsp;any breach of any representation or warranty of LP Seller (including, for the avoidance of doubt, the representations and warranties set forth in Section&nbsp;3 and Section&nbsp;4) or any breach of any covenant or
agreement made by LP Seller in this Agreement, and (ii)&nbsp;any Losses incurred by Buyer in connection with, arising out of or relating to any breach, default, event of default or noncompliance under the Credit Facility that existed at or prior to
the Effective Time or that arises from or relates to any act, omission, condition or circumstance occurring or existing at or prior to the Effective Time (including, without limitation, any inaccuracy in the representations set forth in
Section&nbsp;3.4). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Buyer shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless LP Seller (and its respective affiliates, directors, officers,
employees, successors and assigns) from and against any and all Losses based upon, arising out of or otherwise in respect of any inaccuracy in, or any material breach of, the representations or warranties of Buyer and the covenants or agreements
made by Buyer in this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The representations and warranties of the parties set forth in this Agreement shall survive the
Effective Time until the date that is eighteen (18)&nbsp;months after the Effective Time, except that the representations and warranties set forth in Sections 3.1, 3.2, 5.1 and 5.2 shall survive indefinitely; <I>provided</I>, that any claim for
indemnification made in good faith prior to the expiration of the applicable survival period shall survive until finally resolved. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)
Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, the indemnification obligations set forth in this Section&nbsp;8 are without prejudice to, and shall not limit or otherwise affect, Buyer&#8217;s rights and remedies against LP Seller,
including with respect to any Losses arising out of or relating to the Credit Facility. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;9.</B>
<B><U>Notices</U></B>. Any notice required or permitted by this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed sufficient upon delivery, when delivered personally or by overnight courier or sent by email (upon confirmation of receipt), or 72
hours after being deposited in the U.S. mail, as certified or registered mail, with postage prepaid, addressed to the party to be notified at such party&#8217;s address as set forth below. </P>

under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Buyer, and any purported assignment or delegation in violation of this Section shall be null and void. Buyer may assign its rights and obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part,
to any of its controlled affiliates without the consent of any Seller, provided that no such assignment shall relieve Buyer of its obligations hereunder. </P>

person any right, benefit or remedy of any nature whatsoever. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECTION</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;20.</B> <B><U>Specific Performance</U></B>.

that, in addition to any other remedy at law or in equity, each party shall be entitled to seek an injunction or injunctions to prevent breaches of this Agreement and to enforce specifically the terms and provisions hereof, without the necessity of
posting a bond or other security. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[<I>Signature Page Follows</I>] </P>
